description: Source code for VectorizedParquetRecordReader class in Apache Spark, implementing vectorized reading of Parquet files for improved performance, including batch processing, schema handling, and column reading logic.

classes.name: VectorizedParquetRecordReader
classes.description: A specialized Parquet RecordReader for efficient vectorized reading into InternalRows or ColumnarBatches, supporting schema handling, batch processing, and column reading.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the reader with input split and context, setting up internal state.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes resources associated with the reader.

methods.name: nextKeyValue
methods.description: Advances to the next key-value pair, returning false if no more data.

methods.name: getCurrentValue
methods.description: Returns the current row or batch depending on configuration.

methods.name: getProgress
methods.description: Returns progress as a float between 0 and 1.

methods.name: resultBatch
methods.description: Returns the reusable ColumnarBatch object for data.

methods.name: enableReturningBatches
methods.description: Enables returning data as columnar batches.

methods.name: nextBatch
methods.description: Advances to the next batch of rows, returning false if none.

methods.name: initializeInternal
methods.description: Internal setup for schema and column checks.

methods.name: checkColumn
methods.description: Verifies if a column from requested schema exists and matches file schema.

methods.name: containsPath
methods.description: Checks if a schema contains a specific path.

methods.name: checkEndOfRowGroup
methods.description: Loads next row group if current is exhausted.

methods.name: initColumnReader
methods.description: Initializes column readers for a given page store.

methods.name: allocateColumns
methods.description: Allocates column vectors for schema fields, using off-heap or on-heap memory.
